scope: Offline Shin-only diagnostic; no production projection, Core scorer, consumer route or Stable change
selection: Keep original parent vectors; max-pool window similarities into the same bound parent. Keep the existing candidate limit, physical citations and final selector unchanged. Windows are captured model-input slices, not new syntax-owned source ranges.
acceptance: Freeze a new local corpus and replay its declared cases with exact parent parity first. No positive rank may worsen or disappear; preserve negative/exact routing. Require an improved miss and no regression on predeclared new questions. Historical Server results are inapplicable; even a pass is experiment evidence, not activation authority.
limitations: Windowing cannot recover text already removed by the native 2048-byte body cap. Longer inputs may hit the window cap; report this explicitly. Same-model max pooling can favor longer parents and is not a calibrated relevance probability.
